data.name: Aura of Decay
data.description: At 8th level, you can emit a 30-foot aura of decay as a standard action. Living creatures in this aura (except you) take 1d6 points of damage per round as their flesh rots. They also take a cumulative -1 penalty to Strength each round they remain in the aura. Once outside the aura, the penalty fades at the rate of -1 per round, but it begins building again if they reenter the aura. Plant creatures take 2d6 points of damage per round. You can use this ability %1 rounds per day. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.|DomainPlantLVL
